messages:
Sasha: Auditor asking for a compact handoff proving the RBAC RoleBinding change for svc-inference-writer in prod was done via approved CL and that any KMS decrypts during the vuln triage are traceable. Need chain-of-custody + proofs.
Liam: Minimal set: PR/CL URL, k8s audit JSON snippet showing RoleBinding update, cloud audit event (cloudtrail/GCP audit log), KMS Decrypt/Sign events with principal & keyId, incident/ticket link, and a signed manifest (sha256s).
Sasha: Can we redact IPs and session tokens? They said principal + requestId + timestamp must remain.
Jane_auditor: Fine to redact IPs/tokens. Must keep principal, requestId, action, resource, and event timestamp. We also need proof artifacts are immutable (object lock or signed manifest).
Marta: For k8s audit extraction, we run:```
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-audit --since=48h | jq 'select(.requestObject.kind=="RoleBinding" and .objectRef.name=="svc-inference-writer")'
``` That yields the audit entry with user.username and requestReceivedTimestamp.
Liam: Cloud snippet we provide:```
# CloudTrail example
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/cloudtrail --start-time 1676040000000 --end-time 1676050800000 --filter-pattern '"UpdateRole" "PutRolePolicy"'
``` KMS events:```
aws logs filter-log-events --filter-pattern '"Decrypt" "Sign" "GenerateDataKey"' --query 'events[*].message'
```
Sasha: We'll produce an export bundle: logs/, manifest.json, manifest.sig, export_metadata.txt. Any objections to using a KMS key to sign the manifest?
Jane_auditor: Signing the manifest is good. Please include the key alias and a KMS Sign/Encrypt event proving the key was used. Attach key rotation history too.
Marta: Rotation record: alias/rdw-compliance-manifests -> keyId/abcd-1234 -> last_rotated: 2026-01-12. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/secure/rotations/rdw-manifests. Attestation doc included.
Liam: We'll include a CSV of KMS events with columns: timestamp, principalArn, eventName, keyId, requestId. That answers their keyId list question.
Sasha: Bundle creation command I'll use:```
export BUNDLE=svc-inference-evidence-1861234000.tar.gz
tar -czf $BUNDLE logs/ manifest.json export_metadata.txt
sha256sum $BUNDLE > $BUNDLE.sha256
``` Then sign manifest with KMS:```
aws kms sign --key-id alias/rdw-compliance-manifests --message fileb://manifest.json --signing-algorithm RSASSA_PSS_SHA_256 --output text --query Signature | base64 --decode > manifest.sig
```
opsbot: export-bot: bundle stored s3://redwood-audit-exports/1861234000/svc-inference-evidence-1861234000.tar.gz (object-lock enabled), presigned link expires in 7 days.
Sasha: Uploaded, manifest and manifest.sig included, redaction notes in export_metadata.txt.
Jane_auditor: Received. Quick follow-up: we need confirmation that no other key aliases were used in the triage window (list of alias->keyId used).
Liam: Will include alias mapping and CloudTrail/KMS events filtered for 2026-02-10T09:00:00Z to 2026-02-10T12:00:00Z.
Marta: Also embedding incident id VT-2026-0423 in the top-level export metadata for traceability.
Sasha: Action items: Liam export KMS + cloud logs; Marta attach rotation attestation and runbook; Sasha produce signed manifest + upload bundle; Jane to confirm.
Jane_auditor: Thanks — once we validate the manifest signature and hashes we'll confirm within 48h. :thumbsup:
Sasha: Noted, closing when Jane confirms.
Liam: Uploading KMS CSV now (ETA 6m).
